sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Alok Kumar Ray is a bilingual poet from Odisha who writes in Odia and English. His teaching background is in political science, alongside a literary practice that includes poetry and anthology editing.

His English collection Sillage was published by Sankalp Publication. His Odia poetry includes Meghapanata, and he has edited the bilingual anthology Trouvaille. His poetry has also appeared in World Inkers.
